result.detail: The counterfactual command removes every edge whose evidence-sidecar row came from a named source file: removing target_disease.json dropped the graph from 37,697 to 26,129 edges (11,568 removed), and naming the asset removed all 37,697. The report states explicitly that this is a removal driven by the sidecar, not a workflow rebuild, so it tests dependency claims without rerunning the build.

subject: EV-3
title: Counterfactual gate implemented as sidecar-driven removal
